tool: Codex CLI 0.163.0 `codex exec` with built-in image_generation
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: 16:9 cinematic conference title background, 1672x941 or larger.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND PALETTE reference only (the selected engineering title artwork): near-black graphite, warm amber light, burgundy accents, muted sage. Create a new scene.
Concept: a literal iceberg, seen in a split-level half-above / half-below-water view. Above the waterline: a SMALL, clean, quiet ice tip with one tiny warm amber light, like a single finished application. Below the waterline: a MUCH larger submerged mass, many times the size of the tip, that is not just ice. Inside the translucent underwater ice, half-embedded and frozen into it, are faint engineering structures: cable looms, small build machines, package-like crates, pipes and connectors, all quietly lit in amber, forming one continuous hidden system that connects upward to the tip. Deep down, one tiny coral-red glowing connector hints that a hidden component could affect everything above. Conceptual, not a literal architecture; no measured proportions.
Art direction: quiet, ominous, beautiful. Cinematic chiaroscuro, photographic tactility, subtle film grain. Night scene: dark sky, almost black still water surface with a thin bright waterline, dark petrol / deep teal underwater gradient fading to black at the bottom. Ice is cool grey-white and translucent, never bright blue. Warm amber glow from inside the submerged mass. Matte, restrained, premium.
Composition: the waterline is horizontal at about 38 percent of the frame height. The iceberg sits in the RIGHT 50 percent of the frame: small tip above the water, the large dominant submerged mass below, widening downward and partially cropped by the bottom edge. The LEFT 50 percent stays calm, near-black sky above and dark empty water below, with faint texture only, reserved for large white title typography. Slightly low camera at the waterline for drama.
Constraints: no text, letters, logos, numbers or UI; no people, boats, animals, food or kitchen; no bright cyan or blue neon, no holograms, padlocks, cyber grids, circuit-board patterns, binary code or floating icons; no cartoon style; no Philips or other brand colours.
slide_plan: Replace the typographic background on main slide 3 with this image as bg; keep the native title text on the left, the small 'dist/ ships' card near the tip, and a reduced 'runs ↓ never ships' label below the waterline.
